about: The overseer pool planner's plan for every recorded transfer of the arena rounds r2, r3, r4, r5 and r7, recorded on the base commit of architecture step 2, before the overseer became a sub-project and before its planning decision moved to the flash router: per channel (each channel's dossier alone) and per round (the batch of its genuine dossiers and the batch of all its dossiers). Each plan is stored without the configuration and the pack identity (the same for every plan, given once) and, for a channel, without its items (its one item, given beside it); sha256 is the digest of the canonical JSON of the whole recorded plan, so a test rebuilds it exactly.
key_rule: <round>/<hub key>: the arena's group, or group::variant for a fault mutation; channel uids and message ids are minted per run
planner: the overseer pool's plan_pool as it stood at that commit (OverseerPool.plan; RouterHub.review_pool's PoolItem: risk_reading of the journaled view, repeated faults of the task)
replay: each round's recorded material replayed through an audited hub (the overseer harness's replay_round with the arena key ring) on a copy of the round
